name: UK flood warnings
summary: No Environment Agency flood warnings in force
state: The Environment Agency had no severe flood warnings, no flood warnings and no flood alerts in force in England at 05:40 UTC on 3 Nov.
for_you: Check the gov.uk flood warning service if heavy rain is forecast.
why: Flooding is the UK's most common natural hazard; Environment Agency flood warnings are separate from Met Office weather warnings.
drivers: Heavy rain, saturated ground, storm surges, high river levels.

rubric.alert: Any severe flood warning (danger to life) in force in the UK.
rubric.watch: 10 or more flood warnings in force in England, or major flooding in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.
rubric.normal: No severe flood warnings and fewer than 10 Environment Agency flood warnings in force.
